infrastructure_guidelines.spaceRequirements: Covered Standing Area: 40 - 50 sq. ft per adult milch animal; Open Paddock/Loafing Area: 40 - 50 sq. ft per animal; Calf Pen: 20 - 25 sq. ft per calf; Feed Store: 100 - 150 sq. ft for 10-cow herd.
infrastructure_guidelines.layoutAndOrientation: East-West orientation to minimize direct solar radiation into the shed. Head-to-Head (central feeding passage 4-5 ft wide) or Tail-to-Tail arrangement (central cleaning/milking passage 5-6 ft wide).
infrastructure_guidelines.flooringAndDrainage: Pucca concrete with non-slippery grooved finish (grooves 1 inch wide, 0.5 inch deep in diamond/herringbone pattern). Floor slope: 1 in 40 (1 inch fall per 40 inches) toward the urine/manure drain. Drain width 12-15 inches with rounded edges leading to an external biogas/manure pit.
infrastructure_guidelines.roofingAndHeight: Gable or semi-monitor roof with GI corrugated sheets / asbestos sheets / clay tiles. Eaves height: min 10 ft (3.0 m), Ridge height: 14-16 ft (4.5 m) with a central 1.5 ft ridge vent for thermal buoyancy and heat escape.
infrastructure_guidelines.ventilationAndLighting: Open-sided shed design with 4.5 ft dwarf side walls and wire mesh upper half ensuring unobstructed natural cross-ventilation. Artificial lighting: 15-20 Lux (1 LED tube per 2 cow stalls for night inspection).
infrastructure_guidelines.waterAndBiosecurity: Clean drinking water requirement: 70 - 100 Litres per lactating cow per day. 1,000L overhead water tank with continuous float valve. Vehicle/foot disinfectant dip at shed entrance.
infrastructure_guidelines.approxCostRange: ₹280 - ₹450 per sq. ft (Total shed cost approx ₹1,20,000 - ₹2,20,000 for a 4-milch animal setup with feeding manger and manure pit).

infrastructure_guidelines.businessName: Broiler & Layer Poultry Shed Civil Infrastructure
infrastructure_guidelines.spaceRequirements: Broilers (Deep Litter): 1.0 - 1.2 sq. ft per bird (1,000 sq. ft for 1,000 broiler batch); Layers (Cage/Slat): 1.5 - 1.8 sq. ft per bird; Brooding Section: 0.3 sq. ft per chick for first 2 weeks.
infrastructure_guidelines.layoutAndOrientation: Strict East-West orientation (long axis east-west) so the sun does not hit side walls directly. Shed width should not exceed 30 ft (9 meters) to maintain effective cross-ventilation across the floor.
infrastructure_guidelines.flooringAndDrainage: Rat-proof pucca concrete floor with 1.5 ft plinth height above ground level. Litter bedding: 2 to 3 inches of clean, dry wood shavings or rice husk treated with hydrated lime (1 kg/10 sq. ft) to absorb moisture.
infrastructure_guidelines.roofingAndHeight: Gable roof with corrugated cement/GI sheets insulated underneath with thermocol/foil. Overhang: minimum 3 ft (1 meter) to prevent monsoon rain splashing. Side eaves height: 8-9 ft, Center ridge: 12-14 ft with open ridge cap.
infrastructure_guidelines.ventilationAndLighting: Side walls: 1.0 - 1.5 ft solid brick plinth, topped with heavy-duty 1-inch wire netting up to the roof. Side curtains (tarpaulin/nylon) adjustable for night temperature and wind control.
infrastructure_guidelines.waterAndBiosecurity: Fresh water requirement: 250 - 300 Litres per 1,000 broilers per day (doubles in peak summer). Dedicated biosecurity perimeter fence (min 50 ft from other livestock), footbath with potassium permanganate at door.
infrastructure_guidelines.approxCostRange: ₹200 - ₹350 per sq. ft (Total cost approx ₹2,00,000 - ₹3,50,000 for a standard 1,000-broiler shed).

infrastructure_guidelines.spaceRequirements: 150 - 200 sq. ft per fly-shuttle pit loom / frame loom. Warping drum & yarn preparation area: 120 - 180 sq. ft. Finished saree/cloth storage: 80 sq. ft dry room.
infrastructure_guidelines.layoutAndOrientation: North-facing windows or skylights for soft, glare-free natural illumination critical for intricate color matching and jacquard thread alignment.
infrastructure_guidelines.flooringAndDrainage: Level concrete floor with excavated pit (3 ft length, 2.5 ft width, 1.5 ft depth) for weaver leg well and treadle pedals. Solid foundation to dampen loom vibration.
infrastructure_guidelines.roofingAndHeight: Insulated tiled/sheet roof maintaining internal temperature below 32°C. Relative humidity: 65% - 75% required to maintain silk/cotton yarn moisture and prevent snap breakage.
infrastructure_guidelines.approxCostRange: ₹150 - ₹280 per sq. ft (or adaptation of existing residential verandah/shed).

infrastructure_guidelines.spaceRequirements: 400 - 800 sq. ft reinforced concrete structure. Milling floor: 250 sq. ft; Raw grain sack storage: 200 sq. ft; Finished flour packing area: 150 sq. ft.
infrastructure_guidelines.layoutAndOrientation: Dedicated entry for raw grain unloading and separate exit for milled flour. Dust-isolated partition between grinder room and packaging room.
infrastructure_guidelines.flooringAndDrainage: Heavy-duty 6-inch reinforced concrete flooring (M20 grade) with vibration isolation foundation pads for 5-10 HP motors. Raised moisture-proof wooden pallets for sack storage.
infrastructure_guidelines.roofingAndHeight: Minimum 12 ft ceiling height with industrial exhaust fans and cyclonic dust collection ducts to ensure clean breathing air for operators.
